Ui.Script:
BENILLA_PAD_FACE = { "A", "B", "X", "Y", "U", "R", "D", "L" } BENILLA_PAD_FACE_LABEL = { A = "A", B = "B", X = "X", Y = "Y", U = "Up", R = "Right", D = "Down", L = "Left" } BENILLA_PAD_LAYER_LABEL = { [0] = "No Trigger", [1] = "LT", [2] = "RT", [3] = "LT + RT" }
-- Windows a pointer is for: the cursor opens while one is up. BENILLA_PAD_CURSOR_FRAMES = { "LootFrame", "MerchantFrame", "QuestFrame", "GossipFrame", "BankFrame", "MailFrame", "OpenMailFrame", "ClassTrainerFrame", "TaxiFrame", "TradeFrame", "AuctionFrame", "ItemTextFrame", "PetitionFrame", "TabardFrame", "GuildRegistrarFrame", "TradeSkillFrame", "CraftFrame", "StaticPopup1", "StaticPopup2", "GameMenuFrame", "BenillaOptionsFrame", "CharacterFrame", "SpellBookFrame", "QuestLogFrame", "FriendsFrame", "WorldMapFrame", "TalentFrame", "ContainerFrame1", "DressUpFrame", "BenillaMobileRadial", "BenillaMobileEditor", "BenillaMobilePadBindings", "GroupLootFrame1", }
function BenillaMobilePad_WantsCursor() for _, name in ipairs(BENILLA_PAD_CURSOR_FRAMES) do local f = getglobal(name) if f and f:IsVisible() then return 1 end end return nil end
-- Run a command of the touch controls' table by key (the host's Ui command). function BenillaMobile_RunCommand(key) local c = BENILLA_MOBILE_COMMAND and BENILLA_MOBILE_COMMAND[key] if c then c.run() end end
-- The table as [layer][button] = command text. function BenillaMobilePad_ParseBindings(text) local t = { [0] = {}, [1] = {}, [2] = {}, [3] = {} } for layer, button, command in string.gfind(text or "", "(%d)(%a)=([%w]+);") do t[tonumber(layer)][button] = command end return t end
function BenillaMobilePad_Serialize(t) local out = "" for layer = 0, 3 do for _, b in ipairs(BENILLA_PAD_FACE) do out = out .. layer .. b .. "=" .. (t[layer][b] or "none") .. ";" end end return out end
-- A command's icon and words. function BenillaMobilePad_Describe(command) if not command or command == "none" then return nil, "-" end if command == "jump" then return "Interface\\Icons\\Ability_Rogue_Sprint", "Jump" end if command == "cursor" then return "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Spyglass_02", "Cursor" end if command == "radial" then return "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Gear_01", "Menu" end local _, _, n = string.find(command, "^a(%d+)$") if n then return GetActionTexture(tonumber(n)), "Action " .. n end local c = BENILLA_MOBILE_COMMAND and BENILLA_MOBILE_COMMAND[command] if c then return c.icon, c.label end return nil, command end
-- ── The layer's bindings, while a trigger is held ── function BenillaMobilePadHud_Update() local layer = BENILLA_PAD_LAYER or 0 if not BENILLA_PAD_CONNECTED or layer == 0 then BenillaMobilePadHud:Hide() return end local t = BenillaMobilePad_ParseBindings(BENILLA_PAD_BINDINGS) BenillaMobilePadHudTitle:SetText(BENILLA_PAD_LAYER_LABEL[layer]) for i, b in ipairs(BENILLA_PAD_FACE) do local icon, text = BenillaMobilePad_Describe(t[layer][b]) getglobal("BenillaMobilePadHudSlot" .. i .. "Icon"):SetTexture(icon) getglobal("BenillaMobilePadHudSlot" .. i .. "Label"):SetText(BENILLA_PAD_FACE_LABEL[b]) end BenillaMobilePadHud:Show() end
-- Face buttons in a diamond on the right, the d-pad in a cross on the left. BENILLA_PAD_HUD_SPOTS = { { 90, -50 }, { 140, 0 }, { 40, 0 }, { 90, 50 }, { -90, 50 }, { -40, 0 }, { -90, -50 }, { -140, 0 }, }
-- ── The Controller Buttons screen ── BENILLA_PAD_TYPES = { "action", "jump", "cursor", "radial", "command", "none" }
function BenillaMobilePad_ShowBindings() BenillaMobilePadBindings.table = BenillaMobilePad_ParseBindings(BENILLA_PAD_BINDINGS) BenillaMobilePadBindings.layer, BenillaMobilePadBindings.button = 0, "A" BenillaMobilePadBindings:Show() BenillaMobilePadBindings_Refresh() end
function BenillaMobilePadBindings_Refresh() local f = BenillaMobilePadBindings for layer = 0, 3 do for i, b in ipairs(BENILLA_PAD_FACE) do local cell = getglobal("BenillaMobilePadBindingsCell" .. layer .. i) local icon, text = BenillaMobilePad_Describe(f.table[layer][b]) getglobal(cell:GetName() .. "Icon"):SetTexture(icon) getglobal(cell:GetName() .. "Text"):SetText(BENILLA_PAD_FACE_LABEL[b] .. ": " .. text) if layer == f.layer and b == f.button then cell:LockHighlight() else cell:UnlockHighlight() end end end local _, text = BenillaMobilePad_Describe(f.table[f.layer][f.button]) BenillaMobilePadBindingsSelected:SetText(BENILLA_PAD_LAYER_LABEL[f.layer] .. " + " .. BENILLA_PAD_FACE_LABEL[f.button] .. ": " .. text) end
function BenillaMobilePadBindings_Kind(command) if not command or command == "none" then return "none" end if command == "jump" or command == "cursor" or command == "radial" then return command end if string.find(command, "^a%d+$") then return "action" end return "command" end
-- The selected binding to the next kind of command. function BenillaMobilePadBindings_NextType() local f = BenillaMobilePadBindings local kind = BenillaMobilePadBindings_Kind(f.table[f.layer][f.button]) local n = table.getn(BENILLA_PAD_TYPES) for i, t in ipairs(BENILLA_PAD_TYPES) do if t == kind then kind = BENILLA_PAD_TYPES[math.mod(i, n) + 1] break end end local value = kind if kind == "action" then value = "a1" end if kind == "command" then value = BENILLA_MOBILE_COMMANDS[1].key end f.table[f.layer][f.button] = value BenillaMobilePadBindings_Refresh() end
-- The selected binding's value up or down: the action slot, or the command in the list. function BenillaMobilePadBindings_Step(by) local f = BenillaMobilePadBindings local command = f.table[f.layer][f.button] local kind = BenillaMobilePadBindings_Kind(command) if kind == "action" then local _, _, digits = string.find(command, "^a(%d+)$") local n = tonumber(digits) + by if n < 1 then n = 120 end if n > 120 then n = 1 end f.table[f.layer][f.button] = "a" .. n elseif kind == "command" then local count = table.getn(BENILLA_MOBILE_COMMANDS) for i, c in ipairs(BENILLA_MOBILE_COMMANDS) do if c.key == command then local j = math.mod(i - 1 + by + count, count) + 1 f.table[f.layer][f.button] = BENILLA_MOBILE_COMMANDS[j].key break end end end BenillaMobilePadBindings_Refresh() end
function BenillaMobilePadBindings_Save() SetCVar("mobileGamepadBindings", BenillaMobilePad_Serialize(BenillaMobilePadBindings.table)) BenillaMobilePadBindings:Hide() end
function BenillaMobilePadBindings_Reset() SetCVar("mobileGamepadBindings", "") BenillaMobilePadBindings:Hide() end

Scripts.OnUpdate: local arrow = BenillaMobilePadCursorArrow if not BENILLA_PAD_CURSOR then if arrow:IsShown() then arrow:Hide() end BenillaMobilePadHud_Update() return end arrow:Show() local x, y = GetCursorPosition() local s = UIParent:GetEffectiveScale() this:ClearAllPoints() this:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", UIParent, "BOTTOMLEFT", x / s, y / s) BenillaMobilePadHud_Update()

Scripts.OnLoad: for i = 1, 8 do local spot = BENILLA_PAD_HUD_SPOTS[i] local b = getglobal("BenillaMobilePadHudSlot" .. i) b:ClearAllPoints() b:SetPoint("CENTER", this, "CENTER", spot[1], spot[2] - 8) end

FontString.text: Left stick moves, right stick looks, LB/RB cycle targets, Menu opens the menu, View the game menu, L3 autoruns, R3 the cursor.

Scripts.OnLoad: tinsert(UISpecialFrames, this:GetName()) for layer = 0, 3 do local head = this:CreateFontString(nil, "ARTWORK", "GameFontNormal") head:SetText(BENILLA_PAD_LAYER_LABEL[layer]) head:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", this, "TOPLEFT", 24 + layer * 196, -64) for i, b in ipairs(BENILLA_PAD_FACE) do local cell = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaMobilePadBindingsCell" .. layer .. i, this, "BenillaMobilePadCellTemplate") cell.layer, cell.button = layer, b cell:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", this, "TOPLEFT", 20 + layer * 196, -82 - (i - 1) * 34) end end
